issues.title: Ingest Union County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $36,256,587 across 37 funds. The largest: County General ($12,817,888), County Roads ($9,542,660), Solid Waste ($4,969,272). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
